fields.summary_ko.0: Eli Lilly (LLY) fair value estimate was raised from $1,328.83 to $1,397.02, with multiple investment banks raising price targets to the $1,500–$1,650 range based on strong GLP-1 therapeutics performance.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 revenue of $24.4 billion (+39% YoY) with adjusted EPS of $7.48, and Retatrutide demonstrated approximately twice the weight loss effect compared to Ozempic 2mg, with A1C reduction of 2.2%.
